Clear the sink and get the dishes done.
translations.Check the dishwasher, empty it if clean,: Check the dishwasher, empty it if clean, and load or hand-wash any dirty dishes. Give the sink a quick wipe.
Clear and wipe down the countertops.
translations.Move small items aside, spray the counte: Move small items aside, spray the counters, and wipe them down. Pay attention to corners and the area behind the sink.
Scrub the sink and polish the tap.
translations.Empty the sink, scrub the basin and drai: Empty the sink, scrub the basin and drain, and wipe the tap until it shines.
translations.Take off the grates, wipe the surface wi: Take off the grates, wipe the surface with degreaser, clean the burner caps and control panel, then put everything back.
Wipe the microwave inside and out.
translations.Heat a bowl of water for two minutes to: Heat a bowl of water for two minutes to loosen grime, wipe the interior, clean the turntable, and wipe the outside.
Sweep and mop the kitchen floor.
translations.Sweep or vacuum first, then mop with cle: Sweep or vacuum first, then mop with cleaning solution. Watch the corners and under the cabinets.
Toss expired food and wipe the shelves.
translations.Remove expired items, take out the remov: Remove expired items, take out the removable shelves, wash them, wipe the interior walls, and put everything back tidy.
Scrub the oven inside and out.
translations.Run a cleaner cycle or scrub with oven c: Run a cleaner cycle or scrub with oven cleaner, wipe the racks, and clean the door glass.
Scrub the bowl, seat, and outside.
translations.Apply bowl cleaner, let it sit, scrub wi: Apply bowl cleaner, let it sit, scrub with the brush, then wipe the seat and the outside from top to bottom.
translations.Apply cleaner to the walls and tub, scru: Apply cleaner to the walls and tub, scrub the grout and tiles, descale the showerhead if needed, rinse thoroughly, and wipe the fixtures.
translations.Clear the counter, spray the sink and co: Clear the counter, spray the sink and counter, scrub the basin and drain, and polish the tap.
translations.Spray glass cleaner and wipe the mirror: Spray glass cleaner and wipe the mirror with a lint-free cloth.
Sweep and mop the bathroom floor.
translations.Sweep or vacuum, then mop. Watch the cor: Sweep or vacuum, then mop. Watch the corners and the spot behind the toilet.
translations.Apply grout cleaner, scrub the lines wit: Apply grout cleaner, scrub the lines with a small brush, rinse, and wipe the tiles dry.
translations.Smooth the fitted sheet, tuck in the fla: Smooth the fitted sheet, tuck in the flat sheet, fluff the pillows, and straighten the blanket.
translations.Check the hamper, pick up items from flo: Check the hamper, pick up items from floor and chairs, sort roughly, and take them to the laundry area.
translations.Work top to bottom, dust the shelves and: Work top to bottom, dust the shelves and decor, and wipe the nightstand and dresser.
translations.Pick up items from the floor, vacuum und: Pick up items from the floor, vacuum under the bed if you can, and use the attachments for edges and corners.
Put fresh sheets on the bed.
translations.Strip the old sheets and pillowcases, pu: Strip the old sheets and pillowcases, put them in the laundry, and make the bed with fresh bedding.
translations.Clear the floor, vacuum under furniture: Clear the floor, vacuum under furniture if you can, use the attachments on the upholstery, and move in slow overlapping strokes.
translations.Dust the TV and electronics first, then: Dust the TV and electronics first, then the shelves and bookcase, and wipe the coffee and side tables.
Put everything back in its place.
translations.Clear surfaces, put away remotes and mag: Clear surfaces, put away remotes and magazines, plump the cushions, and fold blankets.
translations.Sort toys into their boxes, put away gam: Sort toys into their boxes, put away games and books, and clear the floor so you can vacuum.
translations.Dust the shelves, wipe the desk and wind: Dust the shelves, wipe the desk and window sill, and tidy as you go.
translations.Pick up toys first, then vacuum or sweep: Pick up toys first, then vacuum or sweep the whole floor, edges included.
Clear the desk and wipe it down.
translations.Tidy papers and cables, wipe the desk su: Tidy papers and cables, wipe the desk surface, and clean the keyboard and monitor.
translations.Dust the shelves, the monitor, and the p: Dust the shelves, the monitor, and the printer, and wipe the window sill.
Empty the bin and add a fresh liner.
translations.Tie up the bag, take it out, and put in: Tie up the bag, take it out, and put in a new liner.
Let the robot vacuum do the floors.
translations.Clear cables and loose items off the flo: Clear cables and loose items off the floor, start the robot vacuum, and empty its bin afterwards.
translations.Vacuum the hallway floor and the stairs: Vacuum the hallway floor and the stairs step by step, edges and corners included.
translations.Sweep first, then mop the hallway floor,: Sweep first, then mop the hallway floor, paying attention to the entrance area.
translations.Line up shoes, hang up coats, and clear: Line up shoes, hang up coats, and clear the mail and clutter by the door.
Wash, dry, and fold a load.
translations.Sort by color, load the washer, move to: Sort by color, load the washer, move to the dryer, then fold and put away.
Empty the bins around the house.
translations.Go room to room, empty the small bins, r: Go room to room, empty the small bins, replace the liners, and take everything to the outdoor bins.
Empty the recycling and sort it.
translations.Collect paper, plastic, and glass, sort: Collect paper, plastic, and glass, sort them into the right bins, and take them out.
translations.Collect all mail and papers, sort into a: Collect all mail and papers, sort into action, file, and recycle, and bin the junk right away.
translations.Check the soil moisture, water as needed: Check the soil moisture, water as needed, pick off dead leaves, and rotate the pots for even light.
Vacuum the floors throughout the house.
translations.Clear the floors of obstacles, vacuum ro: Clear the floors of obstacles, vacuum room by room, and use the attachments for the corners.
translations.Start with the highest surfaces and work: Start with the highest surfaces and work down, hitting every room, and don't forget the ceiling fans and light fixtures.
Clean the outside of the big appliances.
translations.Wipe the fridge, dishwasher, and washing: Wipe the fridge, dishwasher, and washing machine fronts, and clean the handles and controls.
translations.Sort boxes, put loose items in bins, lab: Sort boxes, put loose items in bins, label what you keep, and clear a path.
Sweep out the dust and cobwebs.
translations.Sweep the floor, knock down cobwebs, and: Sweep the floor, knock down cobwebs, and tidy as you go.
translations.Pull weeds by the root in the beds and o: Pull weeds by the root in the beds and on the balcony, and tidy the edges.
translations.Check the soil, water the beds and balco: Check the soil, water the beds and balcony plants in the cooler hours, and deadhead the flowers.
translations.Sweep the patio or balcony, shake out th: Sweep the patio or balcony, shake out the mats, and tidy the outdoor furniture.
Dust the surfaces in the room.
translations.Work top to bottom, dust the shelves and: Work top to bottom, dust the shelves and furniture, and wipe the window sill.
translations.Clear the floor, vacuum in both directio: Clear the floor, vacuum in both directions, and use the attachments for the edges and corners.
translations.Complete it today to collect your coins: Complete it today to collect your coins and keep your streak.
